label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
@Ajay cricket captain after losing the series is exactly what I was going for da. "The boys gave their best, we will come back stronger." Next post I am thanking the groundsmen.

@Rohan fair question. Sneha, thanks for the bodyguard duty, but he should ask. He and Divya put real money in, so they get a straight answer.

What happened: we had a bridge round lined up with a fund in Hyderabad. Term sheet was basically ready. On 28 Oct it fell through. Somewhere in all this a VC partner told me on a call "we love the energy" and then stopped replying for 11 days, so apparently energy is not legal tender.

Without that money, 14 salaries was not possible. Last Friday I let 6 people go. So not half, but close enough that I wont argue. Everyone got 2 months pay, and I have been calling around for them, 4 already have interviews. It was the worst day of my life. Worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and you all saw me that week.

Where it stands: after the cuts we have about 5 months of runway. The app has around 41k monthly users. The plumbers and electricians side is growing. AC servicing is bleeding money, so we are shutting it. The plan now is tie-ups with housing societies, and 3 societies in HSR have already signed pilots.

Your 3 lakh: it is at risk, it is not gone. I am not going to tell you it is safe, because I genuinely dont know, and you would catch me lying in two seconds anyway. You and Divya are in on the same terms as everyone else in the friends round. I honestly think we have a real shot with the societies. I also know "real shot" and "sure thing" are different things, and this is the first one.

So tell Divya yes, it is still a thing. And the sad face, keep it in drafts. Dont delete, dont post.

I dont want to do the full version here with Ajay doing commentary. Let me call you and Divya properly this week. I will show you the actual numbers, and she can ask me whatever she wants, including the rude questions. Just tell me which evening works.

For the rest of you: I am fine. I am eating Maggi at the office at 11pm so often that the security uncle now asks "masala or plain?" before I say anything. Amma asked last week if TCS is still hiring. Very casually, same tone as "have you eaten."

Coming Saturday. Pranav is buying. I have 5 months of runway and none of it is for beer 🍻

---

It's on the long side for a group message, so you can send it as three: the Ajay line, everything for Rohan, then the Maggi and Saturday part.
